taijutsu.perk: +5 stamina and +2 poise a rank; finishers at ranks 3, 6 and 9

weapons.perk: +1 tool pouch slot at ranks 4 and 8; throw recovery -0.5 ticks a rank

ninjutsu.perk: -2% chakra cost a rank; sign time -1 tick at ranks 5 and 10 (never below 2)

pillar_ranks.note: Each pillar has a rank from 1 to 10, raised by use in real fights, drills at the training grounds and a mentor's trial at ranks 3, 6 and 9. The three ranks together cannot pass 3 + level/2, so mid-game you specialise and late-game you round out.

fight_xp_falloff: Repeated kills of the same enemy kind give less pillar XP, like level XP (ROADMAP Levels).
note: power(level) = 1 + 0.03 (level - 1), plus 0.01 (level - 1) more for taijutsu (ROADMAP Levels: +1% taijutsu a level). pillar(rank) = 1 + 0.07 (rank - 1).
